preconditions.name: readout_sufficient_p2_ticks
preconditions.description: Seeds with P2 ticks >= TOTAL_TICKS_FLOOR (4500) so the dispositional map is estimable, counted >= READINESS_MIN_SEEDS. min P2 ticks this run = 7603. Below => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a verdict.
preconditions.control: count of seeds clearing the P2-tick floor

preconditions.name: readout_sufficient_train_pairs_primary_h
preconditions.description: Seeds with usable (z_t, committed_class_{t+H}) TRAIN pairs at PRIMARY_H >= TRAIN_PAIRS_FLOOR (1500), counted >= READINESS_MIN_SEEDS. min train pairs this run = 4062. Below => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: count of seeds clearing the train-pairs floor at primary horizon

preconditions.name: at_least_three_effective_committed_classes
preconditions.description: Seeds with >= MIN_EFFECTIVE_CLASSES (3) EFFECTIVE committed classes (>= 25 train / >= 8 test instances each), counted >= READINESS_MIN_SEEDS. FIX 3: guards the 723 seed-43 degeneracy (one class with a single instance -> effectively binary). min effective classes this run = 2. Below => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: count of seeds with enough well-populated committed-action classes

preconditions.name: action_predictable_above_null_with_margin_majority
preconditions.description: The linear readout predicts committed_class_{t+H=PRIMARY} above the label-permutation p95 by >= SIGNAL_MARGIN_FLOOR on >= MAJORITY_MIN_SEEDS seeds. Absent a real signal, '90% of predictive power' is a degenerate concentration target (undertrained-substrate signature, NOT a workspace null) => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: count of seeds with (bal_acc_full - null_p95) >= SIGNAL_MARGIN_FLOOR at PRIMARY_H

preconditions.name: concentration_control_discriminable_random_ordering
preconditions.description: The random-ordering control needs >= CONCENTRATION_CONTROL_FLOOR (0.25) of the latent dims to recover 90% of the above-chance accuracy (SAME frac_dims_90 statistic the load-bearing concentration gate routes on, measured on the random negative control). If the control is itself concentrated, 'top beats random' is vacuous => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER a diffuse/compact verdict.
preconditions.control: min over ready seeds of frac_dims_90 under RANDOM dim ordering (negative control)

preconditions.name: readiness_majority_seeds_estimable
preconditions.description: Readout is estimable (all floors above) on >= READINESS_MIN_SEEDS seeds; only then is a compact/diffuse branch licensed. Below => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
